start.text: (You got the last seat - the yellow one. A small woman with a cloth bag stops in front of it. She doesn't say anything. She doesn't have to. The whole coach is saying it for her.)

given.text: Live long, kanna. (She sits, bag on her lap, and tells the window about her grandson's wedding in Hoskote. The window is very interested.)

kept.text: (Two seats down, an aunty says 'Youngsters' loud enough for the whole coach. The ajji holds the pole. Three stops. You look at the phone very hard.)

after_given.text: (She's showing the wedding photos to the man beside her now. He's trapped. He looks happy about it.)

after_kept.text: (She is holding the pole. She is not looking at you. Nobody is looking at you. Everybody is looking at you.)
